rules.text: HQ 35 before Season 4. Each HQ level raises the hero level cap by 5.
Squad 1 power = the five tanks' hero power + troops. Drone and research % help fights, not this number.
Exclusive Weapons and gear move Squad 1 power most. Skill medals go to squad-wide skills, for fight value.
One Exclusive Weapon to level 20 before the next. Never Tesla.
Wall of Honor shards go to the hero closest to the next 50-level milestone.
Decoration chests: finish a copy count that's one short, otherwise take a new decoration.
Hero-tree tank research before the Tank Mastery tree.
One queue stays on the Age of Oil until Base Expansion.
Troop slots raise total power, not Squad 1: its troop share held at 9.33M while unit power rose 23M.
Light spend: season pass first, then blueprint packs on sale.

recaps.title: Wall 29, Stetmann maxed, troops back
recaps.sources: Heroes and gear video, tiers / Exclusive Weapons / Wall of Honor video, power details and tank details video, research, inventory and buildings video, decoration gallery video, site checklist and notes, squads video and Drill Ground screenshot

highlights.text: Total power 147.5M → 172.7M. Nearly all troops: 42,919 of 43,118 slots are full, 42.1K of them Lv 10. Unit power 46.8M → 70.3M; hero power rose 1.38M.
Squad 1 30.49M → 30.76M (+0.27M). Tank heroes up 275K to 21.43M; the troop share stayed at 9.33M even with those extra troops. Squad 2 is 20.04M, Squad 3 21.92M, and the new Squad 4 20.56M.
Kimberly reached 50 on the Wall of Honor: every tank now has +1.00% attack. Murphy jumped 28 → 45, 5 levels from the next boost.

Scarlett is now UR, but she's Star 4 and off the wall, with skills 1/1/1 and no gear. That's why Hero Skill and Wall of Honor power fell. Wall heroes are all 5 stars, so that's likely her way back, and it's a long way off.
Stetmann skill 1 19 → max (+11 levels, +49K power), Marshall skill 2 maxed, Williams skill 1 21 → 26, Murphy Ironclad Barrier II to 34.
Murphy's Exclusive Weapon 15 → 16; the next level costs 90 shards and 42 are on hand. Marshall's 2 → 3 is ready at 20.
Wall 23 → 29 and Hospital 28 → 29, both upgrading again. Universal speedups fell 12d → 1d 12h over the same week.
Age of Oil 20% → 28%. Oil Output II is 7/10, and the next path nodes need it at 10.
Your note: use one chest on the Eternal Pyramid (build speed 5% → 10%) and one on a new UR with +300 attack.
Desert Protectors 10,682 / 10,800. Season Boost now on Marshall, Scarlett and Schuyler.

recaps.next: Open both decoration chests, upgrade Marshall's weapon, Quick Equip Scarlett and push Murphy's Wall of Honor to 50.
